<?php
function peerInstall211() { global $receiver, $late; $receiver = new PeerProducerChild211($late); echo 'INSTALL;'; return false; }
function peerShift211() { global $receiverAlias, $late, $owner; $receiverAlias = null; unset($GLOBALS['receiver']); $late = 99; $owner = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerProducerBase211 { public string $text; public function __construct($text) { $this->text = $text; echo 'CTOR;'; return false; } public function capture($saved, $marker) { $this->text = $saved; echo 'PRODUCER:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo 'PRODUCER-END;'; } }
class PeerProducerChild211 extends PeerProducerBase211 {}
class PeerBase211 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $alias, $receiverAlias; $alias = 0; $receiverAlias = 0; echo 'MAGIC;'; return static function () use ($arguments, $name) { echo 'CLOSURE:', self::secret(), ':', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return new class($arguments, $name) { public function __construct(public array $saved, public string $name) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class PeerDerived211 extends PeerBase211 {}
$owner = new PeerDerived211; $prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $alias =& $late; $receiver = null; $receiverAlias =& $receiver;
$factory = $owner->MiSsInG(first: peerInstall211(), later:
    ($receiver
        ->capture(...))($late, peerShift211()));
echo 'RETURN;'; unset($alias); unset($late); unset($receiverAlias); echo 'DETACHED;'; $child = $factory(); unset($factory); echo $child->saved['later']->text, ':', $child->name, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';
